_comment: Golden-set regression scenarios for CodingAgent (G10). Each scenario is deterministic: the agent response is scripted via MockAdapter so these run fully offline. Categories: file_ops, edit, read, search, multi_step.

scenarios.name: gs_write_new_file
scenarios.description: Agent creates a new Python file with specified content.
scenarios.task: Create a file utils.py containing a function add(a, b) that returns a + b.

scenarios.name: gs_read_and_report
scenarios.description: Agent reads an existing file and reports its content.
scenarios.task: Read config.json and tell me what the 'version' key is set to.

scenarios.name: gs_edit_existing_file
scenarios.description: Agent reads then edits an existing file, replacing a string.
scenarios.task: In greet.py, replace the string 'World' with 'CodingAgent'.

scenarios.name: gs_write_with_subdirectory
scenarios.description: Agent creates a file inside a subdirectory.
scenarios.task: Create src/models/user.py with a User dataclass that has name and email fields.

scenarios.name: gs_create_pytest_test
scenarios.description: Agent writes a pytest test file for a given function.
scenarios.task: Create test_utils.py with a pytest test for an add(a, b) function that asserts add(2, 3) == 5.

setup_files.utils.py:
def add(a, b):
    return a + b

scenarios.name: gs_multi_step_read_edit_verify
scenarios.description: Agent reads a file, edits it, then reports the new content.
scenarios.task: In app.py, change DEBUG = False to DEBUG = True, then confirm the change.

scenarios.name: gs_create_class_with_methods
scenarios.description: Agent creates a class with __init__, a method, and a property.
scenarios.task: Create rectangle.py with a Rectangle class that has width and height attributes and an area() method.

scenarios.name: gs_add_docstring
scenarios.description: Agent reads a function file and adds a docstring.
scenarios.task: Read parser.py and add a docstring to the parse() function explaining what it does.

scenarios.name: gs_create_requirements_txt
scenarios.description: Agent creates a requirements.txt with specified dependencies.
scenarios.task: Create a requirements.txt file listing requests>=2.28.0, pytest>=7.0, and pydantic>=2.0.

scenarios.name: gs_refactor_rename_function
scenarios.description: Agent reads a file and renames a function.
scenarios.task: In helpers.py, rename the function compute() to calculate() and update any calls to it.
